authorization_scope: one same-position recovery call per unresolved R4 formal task; preserve prior unknown attempts; resume frozen route

account_usage_guard.limitation: Weekly usage is integer-rounded and may update with delay; no account spend or actual billing is inferred.

prior_halt_guard_superseded_by_user_auth.pause_reason: authorized recovery tasks with unknown deliveries deferred; continue other ready tasks

request_budget_allocation: No project-level cumulative request cap. Each task continuation is a resumable slice of at most 512 model responses; no response is automatically retried.
retry_policy: zero_retries; interrupted in-flight outcome is unknown and never automatically replayed
session_policy: one isolated Codex CLI request per route action; each prompt repeats the compact map, current route state, feature context, and v3 cost-to-go guidance
status_policy: invalid task actions are not executed; task outcome is audited before the next independent task

recovery_authorization.authorization_scope: Recover every unresolved R4 formal task by resending one same-position route-selection call; count recovery calls separately and preserve prior unknown attempts.
